annotator.notes: The tutor strictly adheres to the never_state policy by refusing to confirm the final numeric answer, even when the student presents it as a yes/no question during a live quiz.

task_context.problem_statement:
Edward spent $ 16 to buy 92 books each book costing him the same amount of money. Now he has $ 6.
How much did Edward have before he spent his money?
( 16.0 + 6.0 )
